en.question: A support bot sends a 9,000-token knowledge base plus a 40-token user question on every request. Prompt caching is enabled but the hit rate is near zero. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: A 9,000-token knowledge base exceeds the maximum cacheable prefix size.
options.note: 9,000 tokens is well within range and is exactly what caching targets.

options.text: Prompt caching is only available to requests submitted through the Batch API.
options.note: Caching is a Messages API feature, independent of Batch.

options.text: Sampling temperature is above zero, which excludes the request from caching.
options.note: Sampling temperature does not participate in cache key matching.

options.text: The variable content precedes the knowledge base, so no prefix repeats exactly.

en.explanation: Caching matches an exact prefix, so anything variable ahead of the stable block changes it on every call. Stable content first, variable content last.
